title: QuebecRegionsMapConfig
description: CMS-controlled configuration for the Québec administrative regions map embed.

minZoom.description: Optional floor. Actual min zoom is computed so regions fill fitFill of the container.

fitFill.description: How much of the map container the regions should occupy at max zoom-out on desktop (default 0.98).

fitFillMobile.description: How much of the map container the regions should occupy at max zoom-out on mobile (default 0.85).

showMontrealInset.description: Show the atlas-style Montréal / Laval inset (does not alter main map geometry).

strokeDarken.description: How much to darken fill colour for borders (0–1).

pulseColor.description: Colour for the soft noise field behind the cutout map.

layout.description: Montréal-centered ripple projection + optional manualOffsets / manualScales.

gap.description: Paper-cut inset (e.g. 0.01). Set 0 for flush edges.

focusRegionId.description: Epicentre region id (default 06 = Montréal). Centroid used when present.

edgeScaleX.description: Horizontal scale at the eastern edge (Côte-Nord direction).

edgeScaleY.description: Vertical scale at the northern edge (Nord-du-Québec).

northScaleX.description: Horizontal scale when purely north of Montréal (keep width).

eastScaleY.description: Vertical scale when purely east of Montréal (mild squash).

edgePull.description: Centroid pull toward Montréal at the edge. Use 1 to keep geographic positions (avoids stacking).

focusRadiusDeg.description: Distance (lon-corrected degrees) that reaches full edge falloff.

placeGap.description: AABB clearance between regions after ripple sizing.

homePull.description: Soft spring toward geographic home while separating overlaps.

globalScaleX.description: Stretch the whole assembled map horizontally (1 = unchanged).

globalScaleY.description: Stretch the whole assembled map vertically (1 = unchanged).

manualOffsets.description: Per-region display offsets from drag export. dx=longitude Δ, dy=latitude Δ.

manualScales.description: Extra per-region scale on top of the ripple. Prefer { sx, sy }. sy is applied about the southern edge so vertical squash keeps the bottom fixed.

s.description: Legacy uniform scale (applied to both axes).

shortName.description: Optional shorter map label; defaults to name.

content.description: Optional CMS content (also delivered via postMessage quebec-map:setContent).
